Historical training fronts show paired glazing with a transom. Shared paired-transom and stacked-open-balcony capabilities encode these relationships as bounded street priors. Neighboring holdout crops remain excluded from compilation and recipe tuning; visible acceptance is pending independent retry review. Visual admission remains pending. Retry cycle 6 module-density correction: training modern stack uses a broad central access pane with narrower flank panes, not repeated uniform triplets. Approximate street-level bayScale 1.10 represents a roughly 4.6m nominal module and groundScale .85 a roughly 3.2m ground level; values are procedural priors, not registered per-building measurements. Construction facts remain unchanged and historic/modern boundary ambiguity is recorded separately.
